about-us.title: About Vape24
about-us.content:
Vape24 is an online vape shop based in the United States, operating since 2023. We sell disposable vapes, e-liquids, salt nicotine juices, pods, mods, and accessories from top brands. To date, we have served 150,000+ customers and fulfilled 80,000+ orders shipped to states where the sale of vaping products is legal.

What Is Vape24?

Vape24 is a U.S.-based online retailer specializing in premium, 100% authentic vaping products. We carry a curated catalog of disposable vapes, e-liquids (freebase and salt nicotine), pod systems, starter kits, mods, coils, and accessories — all sourced directly from manufacturers and authorized distributors.

Our mission is to give adult vapers (21+) a reliable, transparent shopping experience with genuine products, competitive prices, fast shipping, and responsive customer support.

Why Customers Choose Vape24

  • 100% Authentic Products: Every item is sourced from manufacturers and authorized distributors. We guarantee authenticity across our entire catalog — no counterfeits, no imitations
  • 150,000+ Customers Served: Since launching in 2023, we have built a loyal customer base of over 150K vapers who trust us for quality and reliability
  • 80,000+ Orders Fulfilled: We have successfully processed and delivered more than 80K orders to customers across the United States
  • Fast Processing & Shipping: Most orders are processed within 48 hours and delivered in 7–10 business days. We ship to all U.S. states where vaping product sales are permitted. See our Shipping Policy for details on delivery times, restrictions, and adult signature requirements
  • PACT Act & FDA Compliant: We implement age verification on every order. All deliveries require an adult signature (21+) in full compliance with the PACT Act, FDA regulations, and applicable state laws
  • Real Customer Support: Questions about a product or an order? Our team responds at [email protected] — real people, not bots

Products We Sell

Vape24 offers a curated selection of vaping products across these categories:

  • Disposable Vapes: From 5,000 to 100,000+ puff devices from brands like Lost Mary, Elf Bar, RAZ, Orion Bar, Geek Bar, and more
  • E-Liquids & Vape Juice: Freebase (0mg–12mg) and salt nicotine (20mg–50mg) in a wide variety of flavors
  • Pod Systems & Starter Kits: Beginner-friendly and advanced pod devices
  • Mods & Tanks: Advanced vaping hardware for experienced users
  • Coils, Batteries & Accessories: Replacement parts and accessories from leading manufacturers

Where We Ship

Vape24 is based in Florida and ships to customers in U.S. states where the sale and delivery of vaping products is legal. Due to varying state regulations, we do not ship to all 50 states. For a complete overview of shipping destinations, processing times, adult signature requirements, and carrier details, visit our Shipping Policy page.

Our Commitment to Responsible Vaping

  • Youth Prevention: We implement industry-leading age verification at checkout and require an adult signature (21+) on every delivery. We have zero tolerance for underage sales
  • Product Authenticity: We only stock products from verified manufacturers and authorized distributors. Every product is genuine and traceable
  • Regulatory Compliance: We operate in full compliance with the PACT Act, FDA regulations, and all applicable state and federal laws governing the online sale and shipment of vaping products
  • Customer Transparency: Clear pricing, honest product descriptions, straightforward policies. No hidden fees, no misleading claims. Review our full Terms & Conditions for complete details

Frequently Asked Questions About Vape24

Below are some of the most common questions we receive. For a complete list, visit our FAQ page.

Is Vape24 a legitimate online vape store?

Yes. Vape24 has been operating since 2023 and has served over 150,000 customers with 80,000+ orders fulfilled. We sell only 100% authentic products from authorized distributors and comply with all federal and state regulations including the PACT Act.

Does Vape24 sell authentic products?

Yes. Every product in our catalog is sourced directly from the manufacturer or through authorized distribution channels. We guarantee the authenticity of every item we sell.

Where does Vape24 ship?

We ship to U.S. states where the sale and delivery of vaping products is legal. Due to varying state regulations, some states are excluded. Visit our Shipping Policy for the full list of shipping destinations and restrictions.

How do I contact Vape24?

You can reach us by email at [email protected] or through our Contact page. Our team typically responds within 24 business hours.

Contact Vape24

We are here to help with product questions, order inquiries, or anything else you need:

  • Email: [email protected]
  • Website: vape24.com
  • Contact Form: Contact Us page

Thank you for choosing Vape24 — your trusted online vape shop since 2023.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.content:
Find answers to the most common questions about shopping with Vape24. Click on any question to reveal the answer.

Orders & Shipping

How long does it take to process my order?

Our fulfillment team processes orders within 24 to 72 business hours (Monday through Friday). Most orders are packaged and shipped within 48 hours, depending on item availability and order volume.

How long does delivery take?

After your order is shipped, delivery typically takes 7 to 10 business days depending on your location within the United States. You will receive a tracking number via email once your order ships. For full details, see our Shipping Policy.

How can I track my order?

Once your order ships, you will receive an email with your tracking number. You can use this number to track your package through the carrier's website, or check your order status in your account dashboard.

Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?

If your order has not yet been shipped, we may be able to update your shipping address. Please contact us at [email protected] as soon as possible with your order number and the corrected address.

Do you ship internationally?

At this time, we only ship within the continental United States. We are unable to ship to international addresses, APO/FPO addresses, or U.S. territories.

Why is an adult signature required for delivery?

In compliance with the PACT Act (Prevent All Cigarette Trafficking Act) and applicable state laws, all deliveries of vaping products require an adult signature (21 years or older) upon delivery. The carrier will verify the recipient's age using a valid government-issued ID before releasing the package.

Returns & Refunds

How do I initiate a return?

To initiate a return, email us at [email protected] with your order number and reason for return. Our team will review your request and provide return instructions. Please do not send items back without first receiving return authorization.

What is the return window?

We accept returns on eligible hardware items within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and in the same condition as received. Read our complete Return Policy for full details.

Which items cannot be returned?

Due to health and safety regulations, the following items cannot be returned: e-liquids and vape juices (opened or unopened), pre-filled pods and cartridges, disposable vapes, opened coils and atomizer heads, and sale or clearance items.

How long does it take to receive my refund?

Once we receive and inspect your returned item, refunds are processed within 5 business days. Depending on your bank or credit card company, it may take an additional 5-10 business days for the refund to appear on your statement.

Is there a restocking fee?

Yes, returns due to customer error or change of mind are subject to a 15% restocking fee. Original shipping costs are also non-refundable. Exchanges for defective or damaged items are not subject to restocking fees.

Products

Are your products authentic?

Yes, Vape24 only sells 100% authentic products sourced directly from manufacturers and authorized distributors. We guarantee the authenticity of every item we sell.

How should I store my vape batteries safely?

Always store batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Use a dedicated battery case when not in use, never carry loose batteries in your pocket, and avoid exposing batteries to extreme temperatures. Replace batteries that show signs of damage, wrapping wear, or reduced performance.

What nicotine levels are available?

We offer a wide range of nicotine levels to suit different preferences, from nicotine-free (0mg) options to higher concentrations. Salt nicotine e-liquids typically range from 20mg to 50mg, while freebase e-liquids are available from 0mg to 12mg. Check individual product listings for available nicotine strengths.

What if a product I want is out of stock?

If a product is out of stock, you can sign up for restock notifications on the product page. We regularly restock popular items and will notify you via email when the item becomes available again.

Account & Promotions

How do I use a promo code?

Enter your promo code in the discount code field during checkout and click "Apply." The discount will be reflected in your order total. Promo codes cannot be combined with other offers unless specifically stated, and some exclusions may apply.

How do I subscribe to the newsletter?

You can subscribe to our newsletter by entering your email address in the signup form at the bottom of our website. Subscribers receive exclusive deals, new product announcements, and special promotions. You can unsubscribe at any time.

I'm having trouble with my account. What should I do?

If you're experiencing issues with your account (login problems, password reset, etc.), please try the "Forgot Password" link on the login page. If the issue persists, contact us at [email protected] and we'll help you resolve it.

Age Verification

Why do you require age verification?

Federal law requires that all purchasers of vaping and tobacco products be at least 21 years of age. We are committed to preventing underage sales and complying with all applicable federal and state regulations, including the PACT Act.

What information is needed for age verification?

We require your full legal name, permanent address, and date of birth. This information is automatically verified through our third-party verification system. In some cases, you may need to upload a valid government-issued ID for manual verification.

How long does age verification take?

Automated verification is typically instant and does not delay your order. If manual verification is required (ID upload), it usually takes 1-2 business days. We will notify you by email if additional verification is needed.

What forms of ID are accepted?

We accept valid, non-expired government-issued identification including: State-issued Driver's License, State-issued Identification Card, U.S. Passport, U.S. Passport Card, and Military ID.

Helpful Links

  • About Vape24 — Learn more about who we are and why customers trust us
  • Shipping Policy — Delivery times, carriers, and shipping restrictions
  • Returns & Exchanges — How to return or exchange a product
  • Terms & Conditions — Our full terms of service
  • Contact Us — Get in touch with our support team

Vape24 ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and purchase our products.

  • Phone number

Payment Information

When you make a purchase, our payment processor collects your payment details (credit/debit card number, billing address). We do not store your complete payment information on our servers.

Automatically Collected Information

When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:

  • IP address and geolocation data
  • Browser type and version
  • Device type and operating system
  • Pages visited and time spent on each page
  • Referring website or link
  • Click patterns and browsing behavior

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience. For detailed information about the cookies we use, please refer to our Cookie Policy.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

  • Order Processing: To process and fulfill your orders, including payment processing, shipping, and delivery
  • Age Verification: To verify that customers meet the minimum age requirement of 21 years
  • Account Management: To create and manage your customer account
  • Communication: To send order confirmations, shipping updates, and respond to your inquiries
  • Marketing: To send promotional emails and offers (with your consent; you can opt out at any time)
  • Website Improvement: To analyze usage patterns and improve our website, products, and services
  • Legal Compliance: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, and legal processes
  • Fraud Prevention: To detect and prevent fraudulent transactions and unauthorized access

3. Sharing Your Information with Third Parties

We may share your information with the following types of third parties:

  • Shipping Carriers: To deliver your orders and provide tracking information
  • Payment Processors: To securely process your payments
  • Age Verification Services: To verify customer age in compliance with federal and state regulations
  • Analytics Providers: To help us understand website usage and improve our services
  • Legal Authorities: When required by law, subpoena, or other legal process

We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

4. Age Verification Data

Due to the age-restricted nature of our products, we collect and process age verification data. This data is:

  • Collected solely for the purpose of verifying that you are 21 years of age or older
  • Processed through secure, third-party verification services
  • Encrypted during transmission and storage
  • Retained only as long as necessary for compliance purposes
  • Not used for marketing or any purpose other than age verification

5. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including:

  • SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmissions
  • Secure storage of personal data with access controls
  • Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
  • Employee training on data protection best practices

While we take reasonable precautions to protect your data, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security of your information.

6. Your Rights (CCPA)

If you are a California resident, you have the following rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA):

  • Right to Know: You can request information about what personal data we collect and how it is used
  • Right to Delete: You can request that we delete your personal information, subject to certain exceptions
  • Right to Opt-Out: You can opt out of the sale of your personal information (we do not sell personal data)
  • Right to Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at [email protected]. We will respond to your request within 45 days.

7. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When your data is no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymize it.

8. Children's Privacy

Our website and products are not intended for anyone under the age of 21. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we learn that we have inadvertently collected information from someone under 21, we will take immediate steps to delete that information.

9. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

10. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational, or regulatory reasons. We will post the updated policy on this page with a new "Last Updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

return-policy.title: Return Policy
return-policy.content:
Last Updated: February 2026

At Vape24, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. Please review our return policy below to understand how returns, exchanges, and refunds are handled.

1. Return Window

We accept returns on eligible items within 14 days of delivery. If 14 days have passed since you received your purchase, we are unable to offer a refund or exchange.

2. Eligibility Requirements

To be eligible for a return, items must meet the following conditions:

  • The item must be unused and in the same condition as when you received it
  • The item must be in its original packaging with all accessories, manuals, and components included
  • You must provide a receipt or proof of purchase
  • The item must not fall under our non-returnable items category

3. Non-Returnable Items

Due to health and safety regulations, the following items cannot be returned:

  • E-liquids and vape juices (opened or unopened)
  • Pre-filled pods and cartridges
  • Disposable vapes
  • Coils and atomizer heads (opened)
  • Sale or clearance items
  • Any item that shows signs of use, damage, or tampering

These restrictions are in place to comply with health regulations governing nicotine and tobacco-related products.

4. Restocking Fee

Returns due to customer error, change of mind, or orders missing items from original packaging are subject to a 15% restocking fee, which will be deducted from your refund amount.

5. Exchange Policy

We offer exchanges for items that are defective or damaged upon arrival. If you receive a defective or damaged item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with:

  • Your order number
  • Clear photos of the defective or damaged item
  • A description of the issue

We will review your request and provide a prepaid return label for eligible exchanges.

6. Refund Process

Once we receive and inspect your returned item, we will send you an email confirming receipt and let you know whether your refund has been approved or denied.

  • Approved refunds will be processed to your original payment method within 5 business days
  • Depending on your bank or credit card company, it may take an additional 5-10 business days for the refund to appear on your statement
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable
  • The cost of return shipping is the customer's responsibility (except for defective/damaged items)

7. Gift Returns

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you will receive a gift certificate for the value of your return. If the item was not marked as a gift, the refund will be issued to the original purchaser.

8. How to Initiate a Return

To initiate a return, please follow these steps:

  • Step 1: Email us at [email protected] with your order number and reason for return
  • Step 2: Wait for our team to review your request and provide return instructions
  • Step 3: Ship the item back to us using the address provided in our return instructions
  • Step 4: Once received and inspected, we will process your refund or exchange

Important: Do not send items back without first contacting us for return authorization. Unauthorized returns may not be processed.

9. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our return policy, please contact us:

  • Email: [email protected]
  • Website: vape24.com

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.content:
Last Updated: February 2026

Thank you for shopping with Vape24. Please review our shipping policy below to understand how we process and deliver your orders.

1. Processing Time

Our fulfillment team processes orders within 24 to 72 business hours (Monday through Friday, excluding holidays). Most orders are packaged and shipped within 48 hours, depending on item availability and order volume.

Orders placed on weekends or holidays will begin processing the next business day. During peak periods or promotional events, processing times may be slightly longer.

2. Delivery Time

After your order is fulfilled, delivery typically takes 7 to 10 business days depending on your location within the United States. Once your order ships, you will receive an email confirmation with your tracking number so you can monitor your package's progress.

3. Adult Signature Required

In compliance with the PACT Act (Prevent All Cigarette Trafficking Act) and applicable state laws, all deliveries of vaping products require an adult signature (21 years or older) upon delivery. The carrier will verify the recipient's age using a valid government-issued ID before releasing the package.

Packages cannot be:

  • Left unattended at the delivery address
  • Signed for by anyone under 21 years of age
  • Redirected to alternative pickup locations that cannot verify age

If no eligible adult is available to sign for the delivery, the carrier will make additional delivery attempts. After multiple failed attempts, the package may be returned to us.

4. Shipping Restrictions

  • United States only: We currently ship to addresses within the continental United States only
  • PO Boxes: Due to adult signature requirements, we cannot ship age-restricted products to PO Box addresses
  • State restrictions: Some states may have additional restrictions on the sale and shipment of vaping products. Orders to restricted areas will be cancelled and refunded
  • APO/FPO addresses: We are unable to ship to military addresses at this time

5. Order Verification

To comply with age verification regulations, we may verify your identity and age before shipping your order. This process is typically automated and does not delay your order. In some cases, manual verification may be required, which could add 1-2 business days to processing time.

6. Tracking Information

Once your order ships, you will receive an email with your tracking number. Please allow 24-48 hours for tracking information to update in the carrier's system. You can track your order at any time through your account dashboard or using the tracking link provided in your shipping confirmation email.

7. Undeliverable Packages

If a package is returned to us as undeliverable due to an incorrect address provided by the customer, refusal of delivery, or failure to provide an adult signature after multiple attempts, the following applies:

  • A 15% restocking fee will be deducted from your refund
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable
  • You may request the order to be reshipped at your expense

8. Lost or Damaged Packages

Vape24 is not responsible for packages that are lost, stolen, or damaged after they have left our facility. However, we will work with you and the shipping carrier to resolve any issues. If your package shows as delivered but you have not received it, please contact us within 48 hours so we can assist you.

9. Shipping Charges

Shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on order weight, dimensions, and destination. Shipping costs are non-refundable, including in the event of a return or exchange. Free shipping promotions may be available from time to time and are subject to specific terms and conditions.

10. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our shipping policy or need help with your order, please contact us:

  • Email: [email protected]
  • Website: vape24.com

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie-policy.content:
Last Updated: February 2026

This Cookie Policy explains how Vape24 ("we," "us," or "our") uses cookies and similar tracking technologies when you visit our website. By using our website, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, provide a better user experience, and give website owners information about how their site is being used.

Cookies can be "persistent" or "session" cookies. Persistent cookies remain on your device after you close your browser until they expire or you delete them. Session cookies are temporary and are deleted when you close your browser.

2. How We Use Cookies

We use cookies and similar technologies for several purposes, including:

  • Enabling essential website functionality
  • Remembering your preferences and settings
  • Keeping you signed in to your account
  • Understanding how you use our website
  • Analyzing website traffic and performance
  • Delivering relevant advertisements
  • Improving our products and services

3. Types of Cookies We Use

Strictly Necessary Cookies

These cookies are essential for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, shopping cart functionality, and accessibility. You cannot opt out of these cookies as the website cannot function properly without them.

Performance and Analytics Cookies

These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website, such as which pages are visited most often and if visitors receive error messages. This information helps us improve how our website works. All information collected by these cookies is aggregated and anonymous.

Functionality Cookies

These cookies allow our website to remember choices you make (such as your username, language, or region) and provide enhanced, more personalized features. They may also be used to remember recently viewed products or your display preferences.

Targeting and Advertising Cookies

These cookies are used to deliver advertisements that are more relevant to you and your interests. They are also used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement and to help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.

4. Third-Party Cookies

In addition to our own cookies, we may also use third-party cookies to report usage statistics, deliver advertisements, and provide other services. These third parties may include:

  • Google Analytics: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior. Google Privacy Policy
  • Payment Processors: Payment service providers may set cookies necessary to process transactions securely
  • Age Verification Services: Third-party age verification services may set cookies to verify and remember your age verification status
  • Advertising Partners: Advertising networks may set cookies to deliver targeted advertisements based on your interests

5. Cookie Duration

The cookies we use have varying durations:

  • Session Cookies: Temporary cookies that expire when you close your browser
  • Persistent Cookies: Cookies that remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them. Duration varies from a few days to several years depending on the purpose

6. Managing Your Cookie Preferences

Browser Settings

Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can typically find these settings in the "Options" or "Preferences" menu of your browser:

  • Google Chrome
  • Mozilla Firefox
  • Apple Safari
  • Microsoft Edge

Opt-Out Links

You can opt out of certain third-party cookies by visiting:

  • Google Analytics Opt-Out
  • Network Advertising Initiative Opt-Out
  • Digital Advertising Alliance Opt-Out

7. Impact of Disabling Cookies

Please note that if you choose to disable or delete cookies, some features of our website may not function properly, including:

  • Inability to log in to your account
  • Shopping cart not retaining items
  • Preferences not being saved
  • Need to re-verify your age on each visit

8. Other Tracking Technologies

In addition to cookies, we may use other similar technologies such as web beacons (pixel tags), local storage, and session storage. These technologies serve similar purposes to cookies and are subject to the same controls described above.

9. Your Privacy Rights (CCPA)

If you are a California resident, you have the right to know what personal information is being collected, request deletion of your personal information, opt out of the sale of your personal information (we do not sell personal data), and not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy.

1. Age Requirements

In accordance with Federal Law, the legal smoking age in the United States is 21 years of age or older. You must be of legal smoking age in the jurisdiction where you reside to purchase electronic cigarette and vaping products from Vape24.

By accessing our website and placing an order, you confirm that you are at least 21 years of age (or the legal smoking age in your jurisdiction, whichever is higher).

2. Legal Consequences of Falsifying Age

Please be aware of the following legal consequences:

  • Falsifying Age: Falsifying your age for the purpose of purchasing products from this website is illegal and punishable by law
  • Purchasing for Minors: Purchasing items on behalf of a minor is strictly prohibited and punishable by law. This may also result in permanent restrictions on our website
  • Providing False Information: Providing a false declaration under penalties of perjury is a criminal offense

3. Verification Process

Vape24 is committed to youth prevention and implements a secured, industry-leading age verification system to verify every order placed on our website.

Information Required

To place an order, users must provide the following information:

  • Full legal name
  • Permanent address
  • Date of birth
  • Last four digits of Social Security Number (optional, for faster verification)

Automated Verification

This information is automatically verified by our third-party age verification software and cross-referenced with public records to confirm that the purchaser is at least 21 years of age. This process is designed to be quick and seamless for most customers.

Manual Verification

In the event that public records fail to match, or if you do not wish to provide your Social Security Number, you will be required to complete manual verification by uploading a valid, non-expired government-issued identification.

4. Acceptable Forms of Identification

When manual verification is required, we accept the following valid, non-expired forms of identification:

  • State-issued Driver's License
  • State-issued Identification Card
  • U.S. Passport
  • U.S. Passport Card
  • Military ID

ID Requirements

When submitting identification for manual verification:

  • The ID must be valid and non-expired
  • The name on the order must match the name on the ID
  • The ID must clearly show your photo, date of birth, and address
  • The image must be clear and legible
  • The shipping address should match the address on the ID

5. Order Processing Hold

Your order will not be processed until age verification is complete. Please note:

  • Orders may be held pending successful age verification
  • We reserve the right to request additional identification at any time
  • We reserve the right to deny and cancel any order if proper identification cannot be provided in a timely manner
  • Refunds for cancelled orders due to failed age verification will be processed according to our Return Policy

6. Adult Signature Delivery

In compliance with the PACT Act and applicable state laws, all deliveries require an adult signature (21 years or older) upon delivery. The carrier will verify the recipient's age using a valid government-issued ID before releasing the package.

Packages cannot be:

  • Left unattended at the delivery address
  • Signed for by anyone under 21 years of age
  • Redirected to alternative pickup locations that cannot verify age

For more information about how we handle your personal data, please review our Privacy Policy.
